The attached three existing icons are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their simple handmade cream-and-muted-teal shapes, slightly wobbly dark navy ink contours, tiny expressive half-lidded dot/dash eyes, sparse repair stitches and restrained worn-paper print grain. Keep the quiet odd personality and strong readable silhouette; do not copy their rocket, robot or fox subjects. Subject: a small plump dragon with cream belly, teal patchwork back, stubby wings, rounded snout and a small crooked smile, no flames. Mood: merry. One large complete subject centered in a square canvas, all limbs/ears/props contained with comfortable transparent margins; readable at 48px. Flat restrained illustration, minimal detail. Genuine transparent alpha background; remove the reference images' opaque navy backdrop. No people, human heads, human faces, anime anatomy, realistic fur, glossy 3D, gradients, scene, ground, cast shadow, opaque square or circle, text, letters, numbers, logos, border, watermark or checkerboard. One finished standalone icon only.
